deadline.value: Admission is continuous through the year with no fixed deadline, but a PhD position advert may set its own closing date.
deadline.quote: Acceptance to a PhD-programme is done continuously throughout the academic year and is not restricted to the beginning of term.

also.quote: The deadlines vary depending upon the individual vacancies

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on NTNU's PhD pages.

supervisor.value: The application must be recommended by the main supervisor before it goes to the faculty, so a supervisor must be agreed beforehand.
supervisor.quote: recommended by the main supervisor, the head of the programme council and the Head of Department

funding.value: Most NTNU PhD candidates are paid research fellows, but funding must be documented before admission.
funding.quote: Most PhD candidates at NTNU are employed as PhD research fellows (stipendiat) at NTNU or a university college.

entry_route.value: The general route is a master's degree with a B average; comparable documented background can also be accepted.
entry_route.quote: The general admission criteria consist of a master’s degree with B as minimum average grade

notes: PHMA. Also_fields statistics: the programme page says of its research fields: "Some of the main fields within mathematical sciences are linked to research that covers a wide range of mathematics, mathematical didactics, numerics and statistics". Coursework is 30 ECTS. No department fee, GRE or English rule.
name: PhD in Mathematical Sciences
